## Downloads

> The **Source code** links at the bottom are added by GitHub to every release automatically. To run EasyLog, download one of the files in the table below.

| File | For | How to start it |
|---|---|---|
| `EasyLog-macOS.zip` | macOS | Unzip it and move **EasyLog** to Applications. The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**, because it isn't signed by Apple. |
| `EasyLog-Windows.zip` | Windows | Unzip it and run `EasyLog.exe` inside the `EasyLog` folder. |
| `EasyLog-Linux.tar.gz` | Linux | Extract it and run `EasyLog/bin/EasyLog`. |
| `EasyLog.jar` | Any system with Java 21 or newer | `java -jar EasyLog.jar` |

The macOS, Windows and Linux apps include Java, so nothing else needs to be installed.

See the [README](https://github.com/AhmedAbdelaty22/EasyLog#readme) for what EasyLog does and how to use it.
